headline: Pakistan Reduces Petrol Price by One Rupee, Leaves Diesel Unchanged
summary: Pakistan's official ex-depot petrol price was reduced by one rupee per litre, while diesel prices were kept unchanged.
why: Regulated fuel price adjustments influence domestic transport costs and retail inflation in energy-importing economies.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Lower retail fuel prices marginally ease transport and energy costs domestically.
